chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: When he resolved to fight the Kharijites, it was said to him: 'Indeed, the people have crossed the bridge of Nahrawan.'

key_terms.النَّهْرَوَانِ: Nahrawan, a location near Baghdad where the final battle with the Kharijites took place.
key_terms.الْخَوَارِجِ: The Kharijites, a early Islamic sect known for their rebellion against Imam Ali.
key_terms.جِسْرَ: Bridge, referring to the strategic crossing point at Nahrawan.

ai.seo_question: What happened when Imam Ali resolved to fight the Kharijites at Nahrawan?
ai.summary: This narration captures the precise moment before the Battle of Nahrawan, where Imam Ali (AS) received news that the Kharijites had crossed the bridge, signaling the imminent clash. Historically, this event marked the culmination of the Kharijite rebellion, distinguishing them from the earlier Battle of Siffin as a conflict against a distinct, ideologically rigid faction. The crossing of the bridge symbolizes their decisive commitment to battle, prompting Ali’s strategic response to quell the internal dissent that threatened the unity of the Muslim community.
